effect.shortEffect: Creates an Electric Terrain when entering battle, and boosts Special Attack while active.
effect.full: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.

french.sv: Le Pokémon crée un champ électrifié quand il rejoint\nle combat. Une machine du futur fait monter son Attaque\nSpéciale si un champ électrifié est actif.

english.sv: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.

japanese.sv: 登場したとき　エレキフィールドを　はる。 エレキフィールドだと　未来の 機関により　特攻が　高まる。
